gates.name: Run tests
gates.detail: 480 tests, 472 pass, 3 fail, 5 skipped. All three failures are file-level synthetic entries (dist/records/index.test.js, dist/session-manager/index.test.js, dist/store/index.test.js), each wrapping the identical pre-existing Windows issue: 'Error: A resource generated asynchronous activity after the test ended. This activity created the error "Error: A FileHandle object was closed during garbage collection..." which triggered an uncaughtException event, caught by the test runner.' No individual named assertion failed in any of the three files. records/index.test.js is untouched by this slice and fails identically, confirming this is pre-existing environment flakiness (matches the fix-257 blob-write/GC synchronization issue already on record for this repo), not a regression introduced here.
